name: najah-erp-whatsapp
description: WhatsApp Integration Service for Najah ERP

scripts.clean: if exist node_modules rmdir /s /q node_modules && if exist package-lock.json del package-lock.json
scripts.logs: powershell -Command "if (Test-Path 'G:/Publish/Najah.ERP.Whatsapp/current/logs/*.log') { Get-Content 'G:/Publish/Najah.ERP.Whatsapp/current/logs/*.log' -Tail 50 } else { Write-Host 'No log files found. Logs will be created when the application writes them.' -ForegroundColor Yellow }"
scripts.logs:error: powershell -Command "if (Test-Path 'G:/Publish/Najah.ERP.Whatsapp/current/logs/*.log') { Get-Content 'G:/Publish/Najah.ERP.Whatsapp/current/logs/*.log' | Select-String 'error' -Context 2,2 } else { Write-Host 'No log files found.' -ForegroundColor Yellow }"
scripts.logs:iis: powershell -Command "if (Test-Path 'G:/Publish/Najah.ERP.Whatsapp/current/iisnode/*.txt') { Get-Content (Get-ChildItem 'G:/Publish/Najah.ERP.Whatsapp/current/iisnode/*.txt' | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1).FullName -Tail 50 } else { Write-Host 'No IIS node logs found. Logs will be created when errors occur.' -ForegroundColor Yellow }"
scripts.status:all: npm run status && curl -s http://localhost:8090/status || echo 'Service not responding'
scripts.help: powershell -Command "Write-Host 'Available commands:' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '  npm run dev         - Start in development mode'; Write-Host '  npm run deploy      - Deploy to production'; Write-Host '  npm run rollback    - Rollback to previous version'; Write-Host '  npm run logs        - View recent logs'; Write-Host '  npm run status      - Check service status'; Write-Host '  npm run sessions    - List WhatsApp sessions'"

author: Najah Team
